metadata.title: Walker-TANK: Shaders, Predicted and Measured
metadata.audience: CSYE7270 students adding shaders to small games with Walker + Claude Code
metadata.note: godot-gamedev walker mode, assignment-focused short film (A5 shaders only). Existing captures only; no Godot launched, no paid API, no upload, no game change.

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN + walker B00. Illustrative reconstruction of a Walker prompt; not the original chat.
beats.narration_text: Hola, this is Liam, in for Bear. Walker tank is a 2D, top down tank game, and Assignment Five gave it shaders. The prompt on screen is a reconstruction.

show.event: result lines: reconstruction label, the state, the 3D object, the revision

props.command: Please use Walker to convert my game design document about walker-TANK — a 2D top-down tank battle — into a red hit flash shader for my tank YunqiZ and two brick materials for the cover_wall in my 3D asset room, with predicted pixel values I can check in the engine.
output: State: YunqiZ just took a non-fatal hit — red, fading over 0.5 s.
3D: cover_wall in scenes/asset_room_3d.tscn, two walls · commit 561d47d.

beats.role_note: Recorded headless results (logs/), mutations (step2-output.txt, commit 1718cdd), and the limits.
beats.narration_text: All headless. Fifty of fifty at thirty, sixty and one forty four frames per second. Seventy six of seventy six. Both baselines still pass. Three deliberate breaks, each exit one. Headless can't show the look, the white flash under the red, or the pause rule by hand.

show.event: HEADLESS log table, mutations, limits list

beats.role_note: Verdict: what held, agent mistakes caught, contributions, texture source, one next step, revision.
beats.narration_text: The verdict, at commit five six one d four seven d. The predictions held, except one pixel on the wrong layer. Agent mistakes the student caught: a CLAUDE dot M D scope too narrow, wrong Use External key names in the materials test, and a probe script left in logs. The student typed all three shaders from Claude chat's suggestions, and wrote the language notes in Chinese, translated. Claude Code wrote the driver, tests, materials, tools and document drafts. Bricks: Poly Haven, Rob Tuytel, C C zero. Next step: check the pause rule by hand.

artifactLines: Held: P2 exact, hint bands 6/6, both edits as predicted; P1 missed (turret layer), revised and dated.
Agent mistakes caught: CLAUDE.md scope too narrow · Use External key names in test_materials · a probe script left in logs/.
Student: typed all three shaders from Claude chat's suggestions; LANGUAGE-NOTES answers written in Chinese, translated.
Claude Code: the driver, tests, materials, tools and document drafts.
Texture: Poly Haven red_bricks_04, Rob Tuytel, CC0.
Next step: check the pause rule by hand in a windowed run.

beats.role_note: HANDOFF: prompt read aloud verbatim and discussed; Liam signs off here.
beats.narration_text: Your turn. Please use Walker to add one shader effect to my game. Predict two pixel values by hand, on the final drawn layer. Then write a headless test, and a windowed capture tool to measure them. Predict first, then measure, because headless never draws. Liam, in for Bear.
